name: Ley Lines
description: Naturally occurring ley lines have been connected into a circle of power.
effects: Naturally occurring ley lines have been connected into a circle of power.

source_abilities.name: Ley Lines
source_abilities.description:
Connects naturally occurring ley lines to create a circle of power which, while standing within it, reduces spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay by 15%.
Duration: 20s
Maximum Charges: 2
Cannot be executed while under the effect of Ley Lines.
